TOTAL OFFERING 100% 1,000,000,000 Community The community allocation combines strategic multi-phase airdrops with comprehensive reward mechanisms, serving as a cornerstone of the Xterio ecosystem. This allocation is designed to build and maintain a vibrant, engaged community through continuous airdrop campaigns and participation incentives. Our target segments include active gamers and AI product users, community contributors and content creators, individual developers and AI innovators, strategic airdrop participants, and long-term ecosystem supporters. We shall incentivize the above different active targtetted users by executing systematic airdrop campaigns across multiple phases to drive community long term growth and expansion. Ecosystem The ecosystem allocation is designed to expand the Xterio platform by attracting and supporting external game studios and technology partners. Through strategic token distribution, we aim to integrate high-quality external games into parts of our ecosystem, while providing necessary resources and incentives for long-term collaboration and growth. We target to allocate and incentivise external game studios, strategic partners, collaboration funds, and technology providers etc. Private Investors The private investors' allocation is reserved for strategic partners and early supporters who bring significant value to the Xterio ecosystem. These investors provide capital support but also contribute industry expertise, strategic resources, and valuable network connections to accelerate platform growth and market expansion. Team and Advisors The team and advisors allocation is dedicated to rewarding the core contributors and industry experts who drive the growth and success of the Xterio platform. This allocation ensures that the team remains motivated and aligned with the long-term vision of the ecosystem while also attracting top talent and leveraging strategic guidance from advisors to navigate challenges and seize opportunities. Marketing The marketing allocation is dedicated to driving the growth and visibility of the Xterio ecosystem. A key focus is supporting the launch of future product lines, official partnerships, and the promotion of brands and games within the ecosystem. This allocation ensures that our upcoming products and partner projects receive the necessary resources for successful market entry, while also boosting brand awareness, community engagement, and user acquisition across all Xterio initiatives. Treasury The treasury allocation acts as a reserve to ensure the long-term growth, stability, and sustainability of the Xterio ecosystem. It provides funding for future platform development, strategic initiatives, and unforeseen challenges. Additionally, the treasury supports ecosystem expansion, market stabilization, and other activities that drive the continued success of Xterio. Liquidity & Staking The liquidity and staking allocation is designed to ensure a stable and efficient market environment while rewarding community members for their long-term participation. A portion of this allocation is dedicated to providing deep liquidity for token trading, ensuring smooth transactions and reduced volatility. Meanwhile, staking rewards incentivize users to actively support the ecosystem’s growth and security, fostering a stronger and more sustainable platform.
